title: Reference solution: Deploy an application
answer:
Suggested approach for Deploy an application:
1. Implement the requirement in the named App Router convention or trusted server layer.
2. Add explicit input validation and a user-friendly empty/error/denied state.
3. Exercise the normal case and at least one boundary case.
4. Run lint/tests and a production build in the target Next.js version.

Starter to adapt:
npm ci
npm run build
npm run start

Required static markers: npm run build, npm run start. These only provide a limited automatic signal; acceptance criteria must be manually reviewed.
explanation: This reference outlines a maintainable solution path for “Deploy an application” in the context of the supplied course. It is not represented as a complete, production-tested application; adapt the structure, test the edge cases, and verify version-sensitive details. Protected operations must revalidate identity, authorization, and input on the server.
